fit_policy: Unmodified archived H6 guard policy: binomial logit scaling; goodness, crossings, bootstrap, smallest-size/window/model sensitivities. Numerical candidates retained; threshold estimates only if every guard passes.
size_rationale: Final user-selected grid: BOTH X and Z use L=3,5,7,9,11. Every method uses exactly the same sizes and shots. Five sizes allow the drop-smallest guard to retain four; reliable scaling is not guaranteed.
window_rationale: Seven rates per method and channel frozen from historical transition ranges, including prior seed_only control for new common-seed Z baseline; all methods evaluated on full union grid in each channel.
seed_rule: master seed = int(first 15 SHA256 hex digits of h6-matched-2026-10-17|channel|L|p formatted .17g); exact per-point Xoshiro seed derived by runner scalar MersenneTwister draw.
revision_note: Before production, user replaced the initial 10000-shot proposal with 1000 shots, then chose L=3,5,7,9,11 for both sectors. No production trials from superseded proposals exist.
